name: Bossa ganza whisper
desc: Soft bossa percussion bed: ganza-style shaker sixteenths with the classic front-accented push, feather-light cabasa answering off-beats, an occasional triangle ping; stays airy and never crowds the kit.

code.full: stack(s("sh*16").gain("[.34 .13 .2 .13]*4").hpf(sine.range(${air}*.85, ${air}*1.2).slow(24)).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(16)), s("~ cabasa ~ cabasa").gain(${gain}*.5).shape(.35).hpf(${air}*.8).pan(.62), s("~ ~ ~ triangles ~ ~ triangles ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.44).shape(.3).pan(.38), s("~ ~ tb ~").gain(${gain}*.3).hpf(1200).pan(.55)).fast(${rate}).room(.32).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("sh*16").gain("[.38 .15 .24 .15]*4").hpf(sine.range(${air}*.9, ${air}*1.3).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)), s("cabasa*8").gain("[.28 .12 .2 .12]*2").shape(.4).hpf(${air}*.85).pan(.64), s("~ ~ ~ triangles ~ ~ triangles ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.5).shape(.35).pan(.36), s("~ tb ~ tb").gain(${gain}*.36).hpf(1200).pan(.55).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).room(.32).orbit(2).play()
